audit.summary: Major for the pinned release's default ESM2/transformer Stage 2 decoder-training route under nonidentity normalization: training and noiseless validation use D(D(z)), generation uses D(z). The dependency crosses a core learned component's training, validation and deployment. P1 metric reporting, P2 pLDDT multiplicity, and P4 optional shorten-two mask remain Minor. Historical experiment-to-source bindings, actual score shifts and corrected benchmark values remain Needs Evidence.
limitations: P1 — Cluster-density definitions and reported values disagree — Counterevidence: Different conditional denominators could produce sums above1 but require corrected definitions. Either ESMc number remains below ESM2-650M .986; either RFD USR remains below DiMA .10. Other primary metric comparisons are not refuted.

P2 — pLDDT averaging drops within-rank sequence multiplicity — Counterevidence: Unique-output quality is defensible if declared; no duplicates/equal scores remove discrepancy. No historical source binding, generated multiplicities or score shifts are available.

P3 — Decoder training denormalizes twice — Counterevidence: Identity statistics, fixed-point inputs or decoder invariance can remove the discrepancy. README permits skipping Stage 2 using pretrained lm_head; other encoders and historically different code are outside the demonstrated dependency. Actual normalization tensors/checkpoints and historical bindings are missing, so quantitative score losses remain unknown.
P4 — CHEAP shorten-two mask reduces requested length twice — Counterevidence: Current configured/pretrained path is shorten1; original shorten2 experiment binding is absent.
Limitations: Historical experiment-to-commit/config/checkpoint binding and raw generated sequences/metric outputs are absent.
Limitations: Actual encoder normalization statistics, trained decoder weights and dataset payloads were not acquired or executed under the task contract.
Limitations: Available repository lacks conditional family/motif/fold experiment drivers and complete BLAST/NW/CD/PCD/NCD/OT/structural metric pipelines.
Limitations: Two source-map-listed length-distribution NPY payloads remain intentionally excluded; immutable archive/member mappings are preserved.
Limitations: Optional OpenReview metadata/separate supplement access was HTTP 403 during source preparation; attachment existence and later errata/revisions are unresolved.
Limitations: No author-code execution, protein-generation/folding run, empirical reproduction, replacement benchmark scores or validated full repaired pipeline.

proposition.claim:
PCD/NCD count disjoint positive/negative co-clusters divided by a common total sequence count; repeated tables represent the same encoder comparison.

pLDDT evaluated over generated samples; released helper calculates each prediction then returns sequence-keyed dictionary.

The decoder is a core DiMA component; advertised token reconstruction fine-tunes it for decoding generated normalized embeddings through the same inverse-normalization interface.

Shorten-two latent representation compresses sequence length by two and generation samples requested raw lengths.
proposition.domain: Completed report for I25-43588; exact inspected scope and limitations are retained in the report and coverage ledger.
assumptions: Every counted cluster contains a generated sequence and clusters are disjoint.
The written denominator is common total generated or generated-plus-reference sequences.
Three-decimal table rounding bounded by 0.0005 per entry.
Duplicate strings occur within a rank and not all unique sequence scores are equal.
Counterexample uses deterministic admissible scores90 and30; no actual folding-model values are asserted.
Default ESM2/transformer decoder configuration and documented Stage 2 training route with normalizer enabled.
Stored mean mu and positive std s>=1e-5; for nonidentity statistics D(D(z)) differs generically from D(z).
Finite interface counterexample is admissible algebra, not actual ESM embeddings, a measured learned decoder, or a recovered historical experiment.
Length sampler returns raw sequence length; output slice is governed by2*mask.sum.

repair.content:
Recover authoritative cluster denominators/counts and run-specific values; no invented replacement.

Retain sample-index scores or cache by sequence then use occurrence-weighted sums/counts across ranks.

Remove outer denormalization in loss_step, retain batch_get_logits inverse once. This restores a common single-map input contract but does not validate checkpoints or benchmark performance.

Clamp each raw length to raw maximum then compress once, m_i=ceil(min(l_i,Lmax)/2), bounded by latentwidth; retain original rawlength for exact odd-length output trimming.
